title: Ruuhu Muñɗo
intro: E nder defte annabaagal, ina woodi ruuhu mo muñal mum 6uu6naa e 6ernde 6ernde ma66e. E nder gonɗi e sahaa, ɓe njokki e yaakaare, ɓe ngonti yeru mo sahaa mum alaa e hoolaare e hakkille Alla. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sirlu ooɗoo limre nde diwtataa?
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e galle annabaaɓe, kono jarribo am ɓurngo mawnude ari ko e cukalel ngel ɓurmi yiɗde.
Mi heɓi jeertinaango kaaɗdi e koyɗol ngol ɓiɗɗo am renndini, mi hulii ngam kisal makko.
Gite am mbayliima e sunaare, tee mi meeɗaa waasde hoolaade yurmeende Alla.
Uurugo ɓingel am majjungel ngel yottii kam gila woɗɗi, mi anndi ndeen kawral ina ɓadii.
Ɓesngu am sujji e yettude nde nji’annde ɓooynde ndee timmi, gite am ngartii.
Ko miin woni mo ndokkaama limce ƴiiƴam, tan caggal mum keɓ-mi limce sellinɗe gite am.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
